name: visualtex-platform-repository
description: VisualTeX: the macOS and Windows desktop applications and the web edition, with the code they share.

scripts.bootstrap: npm run bootstrap:macos && npm run bootstrap:windows && npm run bootstrap:web
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:macos && npm run build:windows
